steps.text: Choose or randomly assign the Ironclad and the Woodwalkers
Main board 2-player side up; each player's faction board 2-player side up
Each player takes their 3 base cards (star)
Each player shuffles their special-card deck facedown by their board
Woodwalkers: shuffle the 4 inner-forest vision cards (3 crystals), draw 1 secretly; shuffle the other 3 into the vision deck on your board
Woodwalkers: 2 Fighters on each outer forest; Totems and other Fighters by your board
Ironclad: Drill and 1 Fighter on Ferrum, 3 Fighters on each inner mountain connected to Ferrum
Ironclad: all Forge tokens on your board; other Fighters and Golems nearby
All markers and crystals as a common supply
Main board solo side up; crystals in reach; your Woodwalker board and the Ironclad board solo side up
Your 3 base cards in hand; the bot's 3 base cards facedown as the "bot's hand"
Remove WW17, WW19, WW22, WW36 from your deck; shuffle yours and the bot's decks onto their spaces
Shuffle the 4 inner-mountain vision cards, draw 1; shuffle the other 3 into the vision deck
2 Woodwalker Fighters on every outer forest; Drill and 1 Ironclad Fighter on Ferrum, 3 on each adjacent inner mountain
Bot Control Aid open, marker on the Expansive Stance; Turn Procedure card Alert side up; Magic die in reach
Main board (numbered locations) solo side up; crystals in reach; your Ironclad board and the Woodwalker board solo side up
Your 3 base cards in hand; the bot's 3 base cards facedown as the "bot's hand"
Remove IC13, IC17, IC27, IC33, IC36 from your deck; shuffle yours and the bot's decks onto their spaces
The 4 inner-mountain vision cards shuffled as the vision deck; the other 6 faceup right of the bot board as its discard
A marker on all four inner mountains' marking slots
2 Woodwalker Fighters on every outer forest; Drill and 1 of your Fighters on Ferrum, 3 on each adjacent mountain
Closed Bot Control Aid and the Magic die in reach
The Woodwalkers always go first in turn order
Each round: Woodwalkers gain 1 crystal, Ironclad 2
First round: you may draw 4 special cards, keep 2 and shuffle 2 back
Preparation phase: gain crystals and draw 2 special cards
